title: Spot plate, drops that merge
label: Spot plate: a tray of six stadium channels, each with a pair of glass drops, beside a protractor feeler fan and a knurled merge dial. Sliding across opens the fan and raises the merge distance, so more pairs run together.
caption: Each channel's pair of drops is one group: inside the merge distance the two shapes run together into one piece of glass, outside it they stay two however close they sit. Opening the fan raises the distance from 20 to 44 px, and the joined pairs go from 3 of 6 to all 6, each waist filling out into a pill.
